description: This file defines a custom ViewGroup called FitCenterFrameLayout that arranges its children to fit and center them while maintaining their aspect ratio, either letterboxing horizontally or vertically.

classes.name: FitCenterFrameLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that fits and centers child views while maintaining their aspect ratios, making sure they are letterboxed properly.

methods.name: FitCenterFrameLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with a Context.

methods.name: FitCenterFrameLayout
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the layout with a Context and AttributeSet.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the layout and its children, disregarding individual child measurement specs, and sets the measured dimension to fill the available space.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions and sizes child views to fit and center them within the parent, maintaining aspect ratios and letterboxing as needed.
